events.text: Goal! Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pascal Groß with a headed pass.
Goal! Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 2. Malick Yalcouyé (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Maxim De Cuyper.
Taiwo Awoniyi (Coventry City) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Substitution, Coventry City. Sidiki Cherif replaces Ephron Mason-Clark.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Chema Andrés replaces Malick Yalcouyé.
Goal! Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 3. Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Frank Onyeka (Coventry City).
Substitution, Coventry City. Brandon Thomas-Asante replaces Jack Rudoni.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Coventry City. Caleb Yirenkyi replaces Frank Onyeka because of an injury.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Ibrahim Osman replaces Olivier Boscagli.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Pascal Struijk replaces Luka Vuskovic.
Goal! Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 4. Lewis Dunk (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Chema Andrés.
Substitution, Coventry City. Victor Torp replaces Matt Grimes.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Matt O'Riley replaces Charalampos Kostoulas.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Costinha replaces Diego Gómez.
Goal! Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 5. Yasin Ayari (Brighton and Hove Albion) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pascal Groß.
Second Half ends, Coventry City 0, Brighton and Hove Albion 5.
